posts.html:
[image not archived]
    I stand here today to tell you my story, the story through which i survived....

    It was a sunny morn eve, on that faithful day June 16, 2009. I thought to myself silently about several upcoming events, how I am going to pay the bills, what is wrong with me? Then, it happened..

[image not archived]

    Several days before, i came to slightly know a local "freeman" of the town, often walking around sputtering out at anyone who got in her way. Ruxandra was the name, innocent, angry, but most of all not really capable of anything woman. This mastermind would wander from bank to hotel, from nexus, to the garage, until one day, no one could find her. That was the day it happened....

[image not archived]

Panic set in...

    From citzen to citzen from rebel to rebel, Ruxandra unleashed a force deadly upon all those. Many a people thought this was a comic, or even a act. The tank, ruxandra, ravaged the town from bank to hotel. How would one stop her? Could it of been prevented?

[image not archived]


    The main damage came not from what she did physically, but mentally at the time, as a local driverby by the name of Zerg, despite of his recent broken truck due to crashes, bought and drove what would come to be known as the most single accidental murdering spree within such a short time. Had Ruxandra not of been unleashing her fury like a startled witch, would this of happened?


[image not archived]


    After the accident, Some were angry...


[image not archived]


    Some were sad...


[image not archived]


    Some just didn't understand.


[image not archived]



    You question life.



But we all go back to what caused this.. What could of set off Ruxandra on a rampage? We bring our attention to a man of power, but a man never known. A man that is not mere human..

[image not archived]

The devastation before this incident and damage caused by this man was known, but not known how.

    Great pain was caused to people from sources unknown, but at this time, this time 2012, we know. Traian was his name. A man of power. People assimilated into great pain around the world after this accident...

[image not archived]

and then...
